name: Ranked exception list
format: table ranked by size, owner per row, the rule it breaks

name: Revenue by business and facility
format: metric row + one table by business and facility + plan beside it

name: Capacity board
format: metric row + booked against capacity by unit with headroom

name: Route comparison on full cost
format: streams as rows, routes as columns, full cost, margin and eligibility

name: Acceptance check
format: each stream against the permit, the capacity and the customer requirement, acceptable or not, with the reason

name: Shipments against their clock
format: shipments with days held, deadline and next destination

name: Declined, with what can be answered
format: one sentence on why, then the closest question the graph does answer

name: Claims read from the mailbox
format: figures from the record, then the senders' claims as an attributed list that is never counted

name: Provenance table
format: every figure with table, basis and as-of

name: Decline with alternative
format: reason for declining + what can be answered instead
